name: Television
overview: Scripture calls believers to guard their eyes and hearts against wickedness and vanity, as seen in Psalms 101:3 and 119:37, which emphasize turning away from corrupt influences. This principle applies to watching television, especially worldly content, urging Christians to avoid participation in unfruitful works of darkness and instead to live wisely and circumspectly (Ephesians 5:11, 15). Moreover, believers are reminded of their calling to make disciples and uphold holiness in all areas of life, including media consumption (Matthew 28:19).
